newsitem.title: CANADA: Anvil Range says no date on Faro restart.
newsitem.headline: Anvil Range says no date on Faro restart.

text.p: Anvil Range Mining Corp said on Tuesday it hoped to restart its Faro lead and zinc operation in Canada's Yukon later this year, but a specific date has not been set.
"All we have ever said is we are hopeful we will be able to restart later this year," Anvil Range Chief Financial Officer Victor Wells said in a telephone interview.
Wells was responding to reports that the Faro operation would be up and running in the fourth quarter of 1997.
He said the company has not completed negotiations for new financing, but firmer zinc prices have improved the prospects for a restart.
"Obviously with the zinc price the way it is, things are looking more positive. But I'm determined not to say yes until we have a deal," Wells said.
The mine was temporarily shut down last December and the mill operation was suspended earlier this year.
